name: Panda Luck

features.name: Sticky panda respins
features.description: Three or more pandas stick and start three respins that reset.

features.name: Panda multipliers
features.description: More pandas mean a higher multiplier on the bet.

review:
A 3x3 grid with a smiling panda as the bonus symbol. Land three or more and they stick, giving you three respins that reset every time another panda turns up.

Each panda adds to a multiplier on your bet, so the more you collect, the bigger the payout. Don't be fooled by the cute look – it's rated very high volatility, with a 2,124x max. The 97% RTP is excellent and the bonus comes round about once every 95 spins. Quick and fun.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 95 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
